name: Sales
description: Invoices, quotes and estimates with GST and other sales taxes, customer records and sales categories that track to your revenue accounts. Emails PDFs through Ledger's mailbox, files them in Ledger's Documents, puts overdue invoices and follow-ups on the dashboard, and can post invoices and payments to the books.

fields.label: Business name
fields.help: Shown at the top of every invoice, quote and estimate.

fields.label: Footer
fields.help: Printed at the bottom of every document: payment instructions, thanks…

fields.label: Post invoices and payments to the books
fields.help: Issuing posts Dr receivable / Cr category revenue and each tax; payments post Dr bank / Cr receivable.

fields.label: Receivable account (CAD)
fields.help: An asset account code in CAD, e.g. 1200.

fields.label: Default revenue account (CAD)
fields.help: For lines without a category, or a category with no account in this currency.

fields.label: Receivable account (USD)
fields.help: An asset account code in USD, e.g. 1200.

fields.label: Default revenue account (USD)
fields.help: For lines without a category, or a category with no account in this currency.

fields.label: Billable items account 1
fields.help: Account codes where billable costs are posted (e.g. 5850 Billable expenses). An entry posted to one of these accounts and tagged with a customer in Ledger can be added to that customer's next invoice, each item as its own line or several as one line. Up to five accounts; leave the rest empty.

options.label: Sales' own mail server settings (older setups)

fields.label: SMTP server
fields.help: Only for “My own mail server”. Gmail: smtp.gmail.com; Microsoft 365: smtp.office365.com.

fields.label: SMTP password
fields.help: Many providers need an app password here.

fields.label: Send from (SMTP)
fields.help: The sender address when using your own mail server.
